messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: elevated 5xx + timeouts detected in region us-west-2
oncall-bot: metric: gateway.5xx_rate(us-west-2) > 6% sustained for 4m | routes impacted: /v1/generate, /v1/chat
oncall-bot: incident id INC-1968123456 severity=P1
alex: got the page, pulling up dashboards and traces. tagging jin and kiran. @jin @kiran
jin: on it. looking at mesh traces and pod logs now
kiran: quick check: any infra events or deploys around this window?
deploy-bot: Rollout: model-serving v2.5.0 -> us-west-2 started at 14:01 UTC
jin: logs show repeated "503 backend unavailable" and gateway connection resets to model-backend pool. also seeing repeated java OOM in model-worker-7
alex: interesting. LB shows backend health flapping for several model nodes. CPU fine, memory spikes then OOMs
kiran: could be a memory regression in the new image. can we reduce traffic to the region while we triage?
alex: two immediate mitigations to consider: 1) shift weight at edge to other regions (us-east-1) 2) enable lightweight fallback model for noisy customers. which is faster?
jin: edge weight shift is fastest to reduce customer 5xx exposure. fallback model toggle exists but needs config per-customer; we can enable a coarse fallback flag for the route temporarily
maria: I can take a short handoff in 25m if you need to push changes.
alex: kiran, can you do the edge weight change? I can flip the fallback flag afterwards. we should also scale up model-serving node pool in us-west-2 as a backup
kiran: running edgectl to nudge weights: disabling sticky sessions for /v1/* then shift weights 20% -> 80% us-east. command: \n```
edgectl route edit --route "/v1/*" --weights us-west-2=20,us-east-1=80 --no-sticky
```
kiran: applied. control plane accepted, propagating to edge (rc: rc-edge-2468)
deploy-bot: Edge config rollout started -> rc-edge-2468
jin: telemetry: within 90s traffic is shifting. us-west-2 5xx dropping from 9.4% -> 3.6%
alex: scaling model-serving nodepool: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-model-usw2 --size=10` to create headroom
jin: scaling kicked off, nodes coming up but kubelet shows slow provisioning for GPUs (driver setup). may take ~3m
alex: enabling coarse fallback for /v1/* so heavy requests get routed to quantized-light model when backend errors > 4% for 30s. feature flag: `runtime.coarse_fallback=true`
jin: flag toggled. gateway now short-circuits to fallback variant when threshold met. monitoring for any latency regressions
kiran: support update: initial calc -> us-west-2 accounts for 3.8% of global qps; erroring sessions were ~28% of that subset so global-visible error bump ~1.1% currently
maria: noted, drafting a short note for customers: what happened, mitigation, ETA. will post when we have stable numbers
alex: good. keep an eye on downstream overload in us-east-1 as it receives extra traffic. set autoscale target there to absorb burst if needed
jin: us-east autoscaler at 70% before shift. can spin up more if we see CPU/QPS climb beyond 80%
kiran: telemetry shows small spike but healthy so far. us-west-2 5xx currently 2.4% and trending down. some older pods still OOMing but fewer errors
alex: root cause hypothesis: memory regression in v2.5.0 affecting legacy quantized init path under certain memory fragmentation patterns. create a tracking ticket INF-4801
jin: opened INF-4801 with logs and sample backtraces. proposing patch to skip legacy quantized warmup for now. testing a hotfix canary in us-west-2 (2 pods)
deploy-bot: Rollout started: model-serving v2.5.1-canary -> 2 pods in us-west-2
maria: will take over monitoring in 20m. handoff checklist: what I need to watch for: 1) 5xx in us-west-2 rising >5% 2) us-east-1 CPU/QPS >85% 3) canary pods OOM within 10m
alex: noted. I'll remain reachable. kiran will own edge rollback if we need to revert weights
kiran: also reminder to re-enable sticky sessions after we restore normal pod health for latency-sensitive clients
jin: canary logs so far clean for 7m, no OOM observed. scaling completed in us-west-2, new nodes stabilized
maria: observed customer impact: acme-data (high qps) reported shorter blips but stable after shift, small dev orgs still noisy but below alert thresholds. sending support update now
maria: support update posted to #support: brief summary + mitigation + ETA for full recovery 30-45m\sre-rotation: react with :white_check_mark: to accept handoff
maria: :white_check_mark: taking handoff for next 2h. summary on thread for oncall: start 1968123456 @ 14:04 UTC; actions: edge weight shift, scale model pool, enabled coarse fallback, canary patch v2.5.1-canary; current state: mitigated (us-west-2 5xx ~1.8%), continuing monitoring\alex: follow-ups: schedule postmortem, add memory-safety test for quantized path, consider deploy-gating for model-serving images to run a short-memory soak before region-wide rollout
jin: will prepare patch for v2.5.1 stable after canary healthy for 30m (INF-4801)
kiran: I'll revert `--no-sticky` and weights back to normal once we confirm stable tails
deploy-bot: Incident INC-1968123456 status updated -> mitigated by maria at 14:48 UTC
maria: creating post-incident doc and scheduling RCA meeting 17:00 UTC. owners: RCAs @jin, deploy policy @kiran, customer comms @maria
alex: thanks team. good quick coordination. :rocket:
